notes.title: Overseer 1.4
notes.content:
Now that I have completed my education, I can dedicate more time to developing Overseer. My immediate focus will be on implementing several key features:


 Enhancing overall game balance
 Refining boss fights for a more dynamic experience
 Developing distinct AI for horde and elite enemies (currently, all enemies share the same 'Elite Level' AI)
 Polishing the menu and UI design, particularly for crafting and NPC dialogue


Multiplayer is something that I've always wanted to implement, but had put off as I wanted to "perfect" the system, with my new skills gathered from completing my Master of Information Technology and my Master of Cybersecurity; I'm confident that I will eventually find a "Good Enough" system for the purposes of Overseer!

~Muddykat

notes.title: Overseer Update 1.3.4.2
notes.content: Improves UI Further, Bug Fixes, Better Training Dummies

notes.title: Overseer Update 1.3.40a
notes.content:
More Sound effects added to the Wizard
More Sound effects for Crafting, Buying and Equipping Items

Fixed Blood Layer Rendering Above Spike Ball Traps
Modified Wizard Beam Ability to follow the mouse rather than clip to it. (Follow speed based on speed stat)

Fixed Beam Disappearing if hitting a tree in the hub world.

Work done on Networking in the background, still not functional, sorry about that. :(

notes.title: Update 1.3.36a
notes.content:
Fixed a collision bug with players getting stuck in walls

Added Juicy effects to wizard fire bolt

Switched out the Lighting engine to a new one, needs more work to make it pretty, but it's about 5 times more efficient

Save Slots have been added however they are still very basic, you can now type in and have usernames!

notes.title: Update 1.3.34a
notes.content:
Large change to the Rendering Engine in this update, Silhouettes are currently not enabled at the moment, they will be added again later.

I've also been working on Getting Networking Up and running in the Dungeon properly, as while you can connect with a friend at the moment, it's not currently playable in the current patches!

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content: Fixed an issue with the Overseer Spawn timer being set to start from the beginning.

notes.title: Update 1.3.31b
notes.content:
Update includes Royalty Free Music and Art to make the Hubworld feel alive and lived in!

New Abilities Available for the Warrior And Wizard!
Forge Powerful Artifacts with Materials found in the Dungeon!

A Stranger has come to the hubworld, he seems a little shady, and while the stuff he's selling isn't ready yet, it seems powerful!

Shadows and Light, Massive Overhaul to the Lighting, Shadows can now be cast in the dungeon and hub world, very pretty!

AI Optimizations, AI is now managed by a single AI control Object, Improving Frame-rate and allowing ease of integration for the future Multiplayer Update.

A refactor of how Damage Boxes Work, same functionality better execution. 
(Mostly so that Multiplayer Hosting Works Nicer!)

notes.title: Update 1.3.24a
notes.content:
This update reworks the dungeon generation algorithm to be based of a 'cheat sheet', this ensures that the dungeons look nicer, and have better designs for traps and rewards!

This update also has improved the quality of the Dialog System npc characters use, for ease of use. This includes a larger font size, and better controls for easy dialog navigation.

The Archer Class has been implemented in the game, however this is a dev implementation, the class is included as template for a future update wherein the class will receive it's own unique abilities and upgrades.
